prediction.family: C89 model of the measured D60C packed span state
prediction.prediction: Initializing from native U/V start and step words, raw destination/texture-base registers, and visible count will reproduce the full DC35..DC87 register packing. Each advance(sampled_texel) will match every captured register boundary through DC9E, including full ECX, U ADD/ADC, texture-byte AL replacement, V ADD/ADC carry, and BP-only decrement, for the 319-sample feedback fixture and the prior 36-sample packed-U fixture.
prediction.source_zero_prediction: A zero texel suppresses the DC96 destination store but does not suppress DC98 ADD EAX,EBP, DC9A ADC CH,DH, or DC9C DEC BP; the C state therefore advances and records store_required=0.
prediction.falsifier: Any setup or per-sample native register mismatch, a zero-source run that does not advance or that stores, or a count endpoint/invalid-input check failure falsifies the model.
prediction.scope: Only the original D60C row-zero route with captured initial words and visible counts 1..320. No geometry-derived initialization, packet traversal, memory dereference, framebuffer rasterization, or CC50/E680 behavior is claimed.

scope: C89 D60C packed span state replayed every captured sample boundary for two 319-sample texel runs, one 319-sample source-zero run, and both 36-sample packed-U texture runs.

limits: The utility advances measured D60C registers only; it does not build spans or rasterize pixels.
Source and destination addresses are raw 32-bit values; no memory is dereferenced by the C utility.
Only the generic D60C row-zero route is covered. CC50 and E680 remain separate contracts.
The 319/36 fixtures validate these states, not every legal register/input combination.
